title: DistillationQAPair
description: Single Q&A pair for the distillation dataset. Two producers conform to this schema: (1) the legacy taxonomy runner, which invents a task from the 4-axis taxonomy and populates only the base fields; (2) the M3 artifact-reverse-generation pipeline, which additionally populates artifact_refs, source_lane, pair_id, student_filter_verdict, verification, and difficulty_mutations. The base `required` array is the intersection both producers satisfy; artifact-based records carry stricter requirements expressed via `dependentRequired`.

artifactRef.description: One reverse-generation source reference. Stores a citation ID plus re-expression rationale, never a long verbatim copy of the source text (copyright: reference ID + re-expression only).

source_type.description: Artifact source bucket. `k8s` covers Kubernetes docs/KEP plus cloud-native OSS GitHub issues/PRs.

doc_id.description: Stable identifier within the source (e.g. arXiv id, StackExchange post id, KEP number, PMC id)

url.description: Optional canonical URL of the source document

license.description: License of the source document (e.g. CC-BY-SA-4.0, CC-BY-4.0, arXiv-nonexclusive), recorded for redistribution safety

locator.description: Optional offset/locator within the document (char range, section id, line range, paragraph anchor)

why_relevant.description: Why this source grounds the reverse-generated question (re-expression rationale, not a quote)

studentFilterVerdict.description: Student pre-filter outcome. Only fail/uncertain verdicts are forwarded to the teacher (that is why this record has a teacher trajectory).

method.description: judge_ref = judge vs reference answer; self_consistency = k-sample disagreement; both = union of the two; disabled = presolve configured off, no student/judge measurement (verdict is uncertain by definition)

judge_score.description: Optional judge score of the student answer vs the reference answer sketch

self_consistency_disagreement.description: Optional 0..1 disagreement rate across k self-consistency samples

reason.description: Why the student was routed to the teacher (fail/uncertain cause)

verification.description: Teacher trajectory verification result. Applied by the verifier step; a record may be inserted before verification, in which case this field is absent.

method.description: How the trajectory was verified: test (unit/regression), rule (rule-based check), exec (execution), none (not verifiable)

result.description: pass/fail for verifiable methods; na when method is none

detail.description: Optional detail (test name, rule id, execution log excerpt)

task_id.description: Unique identifier for this Q&A pair (e.g. UUID or timestamp-based)

capability_tags.description: Required capabilities from taxonomy axis 2 (one or more)

user_request.description: The user question or instruction (input side of the Q&A pair)

context.description: Background context or constraints provided alongside the request

success_criteria.description: Criteria that a correct answer must satisfy

plan.description: Step-by-step plan the model follows to produce the answer

reasoning_summary.description: Summary of the reasoning process used to derive the answer

final_answer.description: The complete final answer (response side of the Q&A pair)

self_check.description: Self-verification items the model checked after producing the answer

quality_notes.description: Notes on answer quality, potential issues, or improvement areas

references.description: Optional external references or sources consulted

artifacts.description: Optional supplementary artifacts (file paths, code snippets, etc.)

source_lane.description: M3 2-lane language of this record. The same question exists as a ko/en pair (linked by pair_id); CoT and content are written in this lane's language. Required for artifact-based records.

pair_id.description: M3 identifier linking the ko/en records of the same question. Two lane records share one pair_id. Required for artifact-based records.

artifact_refs.description: M3 reverse-generation grounding. Non-empty for artifact-based records; absent for legacy taxonomy records. Presence triggers dependentRequired (source_lane, pair_id, student_filter_verdict).

student_filter_verdict.description: M3 student pre-filter outcome (why this pair was sent to the teacher). Required for artifact-based records.

verification.description: M3 teacher-trajectory verification result. Optional (a record may exist before the verifier step runs).

difficulty_mutations.description: M3 difficulty-raising operators applied to the base question (Evol-Instruct used only as a mutation, not as an author). Controlled vocabulary; extended as the M3 mutation step adds operators.

teacher_model.description: M3 metadata: teacher model id that produced the trajectory (records the credit mechanism).

teacher_provider.description: M3 metadata: teacher provider (e.g. openai, claude, gemini), whose credit-consumption mechanism differs.

cot.description: In-band chain-of-thought the prompt forces the model to emit; present for all sources (todos sec 2-5-5). Supersedes reasoning_summary and carries the same meaning. MIGRATION PATH: the two fields coexist for now (removing reasoning_summary is breaking — it is in `required`); once the queue workers populate cot for every record, reasoning_summary is dropped and cot is promoted to required for artifact records via dependentRequired.

cot_raw.description: Raw chain-of-thought from the provider's message.reasoning_content. Only open-weight teachers expose it (DeepSeek-R1/Qwen3/Kimi, per todos sec 2-5-5); null for summary-only subscription providers. Paired with has_raw_cot.

has_raw_cot.description: True when cot_raw holds a provider-raw reasoning_content (an open-weight teacher), false when only the in-band cot is available.
